summary: Iter 34 validated the FOUR new Security Scanner features on /app/security via Playwright. All four render and function end-to-end: (1) Score trajectory chart renders (data-testid=scan-trend, '17 scans', recharts SVG with 1 area path + 1 line path for 'Security score' and 'Open findings'). (2) Chat alerts UI works — alerts-teams / alerts-slack / alerts-save inputs render, Save persists (verified via /api/self-scan/alerts GET → slack_url_set=true and teams_url_set=true after a direct PUT), the alerts-test button appears once a webhook is present and clicking it triggers a success toast: 'Test alert sent to your Teams/Slack'. (3) Maintenance/patch-apply jobs — after clicking approve-dep-starlette from pending-approvals, the maintenance-jobs section immediately renders three rows: job-starlette (queued→running→APPLIED with 'Upgraded — restart may be needed to fully clear · score 76'), job-certifi (SUCCESS, '✓ Re-scan confirms CVE cleared · score 76'), and job-ecdsa (FAILED, 'Failed — no changes pinned' — matches expected no-published-fix path). Auto-refresh works: within the 15s polling window the starlette row transitioned RUNNING→APPLIED without any reload. (4) Live Device Drilldown — device-inventory renders and correctly shows device-note ('Connect Microsoft 365 (Intune) to inventory managed devices and their compliance/health.') because Intune is intentionally not connected in this env; no device rows and no modal, as expected per the review note. Engine controls all work: engine-status ACTIVE, engine-pause → PAUSED, engine-resume → ACTIVE, engine-run triggers a cycle and engine-lastrun updates. Primary vitals still render: vital-app=70, vital-compliance=85%, vital-endpoint=76 with ECG traces. No JS errors during the ~90s session (only benign recharts warnings about initial 0-width during first mount which recover once the ResponsiveContainer measures).

integration_issues.flow: Chat alerts — saving BOTH Teams and Slack in one Save click
integration_issues.issue: During my first Save with both alerts-teams and alerts-slack filled, only slack_url_set turned true on GET /api/self-scan/alerts (teams_url_set stayed false). A subsequent direct PUT with only teams_url succeeded, so the backend endpoint works. The UI showed the partial state honestly ('Teams · Slack ✓'), and toast still said 'Chat alert webhooks saved'. Could be a controlled-input race where React state for teamsUrl wasn't yet committed at click time in headless Playwright, OR the PUT dropped the teams_url field when both were sent. Non-blocking (Slack path proven, Teams via curl proven). Worth a 5-min repro in a real browser to rule out a controlled-input race in saveAlerts.

issues: After saving, the 'Teams ✓ / Slack ✓' status is a tiny muted subtitle inside a busy line ('Push "approval needed" alerts to Teams · Slack ✓') — easy to miss which webhook is missing. Consider two small chips (Teams / Slack) that light up green when set, similar to the sev-* chips.

First render logs two recharts warnings about width/height=-1 before ResponsiveContainer measures. Rendering recovers correctly (svg draws), but adding an explicit minHeight to the wrapper div would silence the warnings.

action_items: Investigate why a single saveAlerts PUT with BOTH teams_url and slack_url sometimes persists only slack_url (verified reproducible once in Playwright; verified NOT reproducible via direct curl). Likely a controlled-input timing issue where teamsUrl React state was still '' at PUT time; confirm by logging body.teams_url on the backend or by capturing the outgoing request in devtools.
Optional UX: promote 'Teams ✓ / Slack ✓' from inline subtitle to two small chips so users see at a glance which webhook is wired.
critical_code_review_comments: SecurityScanner.jsx saveAlerts sends {teams_url: teamsUrl, slack_url: slackUrl} even when a field is empty. The backend treats empty-string as 'set to empty', which would blank the persisted URL. Consider omitting the field when the input is empty (send undefined) so users can update Slack without wiping Teams. Also add optimistic feedback per-field on save.

SecurityScanner.jsx is now 554 lines with dense inline JSX. Suggest extracting HeartbeatTrace (~50 lines) and the Chat-alerts + Maintenance-jobs blocks into their own components for maintainability — pure refactor, no behavior change.
Trend chart wrapper uses style={{width:'100%',height:200}} but ResponsiveContainer logs 'width(-1) and height(-1)' briefly on first paint. Add minHeight:200 on the outer div to silence.

self_scan.py PUT /alerts blindly writes body.teams_url.strip() when the caller sends an empty string, so passing '' via the FE clears the stored URL. Consider treating empty-string as no-op (or explicit clear via a dedicated ?clear=teams param).

Device modal ('device-modal') and 'device-force-sync' cannot be reached in this env because M365 is not connected. Backend path was proven by main agent via curl, so no additional coverage possible from the FE side without a mocked device list.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testids in the review request rendered and behaved correctly (scan-trend, chat-alerts, alerts-teams/slack/save/test, pending-approvals with approve-<fid>, maintenance-jobs with job-<pkg> transitioning RUNNING→APPLIED and ecdsa=FAILED explanation, device-inventory + device-note, primary-vitals with vital-app/compliance/endpoint values, engine-status + pause/resume/run/autoapply). ONE non-blocking observation on Teams+Slack combined save (see integration_issues).

seed_data_creation: Set org.scan_alerts.teams_url and slack_url to TEST_ITER34 placeholder URLs via FE + one direct PUT for Teams. Approved the pending starlette upgrade (this creates a real maintenance job row that transitions to APPLIED; certifi row was already 'success' from prior no-op run; ecdsa is the intentional 'failed — no published fix' path).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All four new features are wired and rendering: recharts trajectory (scan-trend), chat-alerts inputs + save + test-toast, maintenance-jobs auto-refresh with RUNNING→APPLIED/SUCCESS/FAILED status, and device-inventory falling back to device-note when Intune isn't connected. The only nit is that a single saveAlerts click with BOTH fields filled sometimes stored only slack_url in this run — a direct PUT and a Slack-only save both work — so main agent should double-check saveAlerts input state before the PUT (probably use functional refs or await a microtask). Do NOT attempt to force a starlette job to 'success' — status APPLIED is the expected honest outcome in a running container; SUCCESS only occurs when the re-scan post-upgrade proves CVE cleared (like certifi's no-op).
rca of the issue: Teams+Slack single-save partial persist — hypothesized RCA: React state for one of the two controlled inputs was not yet flushed to closure when the Save handler ran because page.fill in Playwright fires synthetic events and headless Chromium batched the state update. Mitigation: (a) omit empty-string fields from the PUT body, and (b) either add a small 100ms debounce or read from refs. Backend endpoint itself is fine (proven via direct PUT curl → GET now shows teams_url_set=true).
